entities.name: Election Commission of India
entities.description: Conducts and supervises elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, state legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President; a permanent multi-member constitutional body.
entities.legalBasis: Article 324 of the Constitution; Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023

entities.name: Chief Electoral Officers of States and UTs (aggregate)
entities.description: One Chief Electoral Officer per state/UT, appointed under Section 13A of the Representation of the People Act, 1950, to supervise elections in that state under ECI's superintendence.
entities.legalBasis: Representation of the People Act, 1950, Section 13A

entities.name: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
entities.description: Audits all receipts and expenditure of the Union and state governments, government-owned bodies and corporations, reporting to Parliament and state legislatures; is the head of the Indian Audit and Accounts Department (IA&AD).
entities.legalBasis: Article 148 of the Constitution; Comptroller and Auditor General's (Duties, Powers and Conditions of Service) Act, 1971

entities.name: Indian Audit and Accounts Department
entities.description: The professional cadre and field offices through which the CAG conducts audits of Union, state and local-body accounts across India.
entities.legalBasis: Article 148 read with the CAG's (DPC) Act, 1971

entities.name: Union Public Service Commission
entities.description: Conducts recruitment examinations (Civil Services Examination etc.) and advises the Union government on recruitment and service matters for the All India Services and Central Civil Services.

entities.name: Sixteenth Finance Commission
entities.description: Recommends how the Union divides net tax proceeds between itself and the states (vertical devolution) and among the states (horizontal devolution), and the principles for grants-in-aid, for a five-year award period.
entities.legalBasis: Article 280 of the Constitution; Finance Commission (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1951
entities.notes: Constituted in Dec 2023; its award period is the five fiscal years 2026-27 to 2030-31 (from 1 Apr 2026). As of the source checked, the Commission's report/recommended vertical-devolution percentage was not yet public — do not invent a figure; leave for a later verification pass.

entities.name: National Commission for Scheduled Castes
entities.description: Investigates and monitors safeguards for Scheduled Castes, inquires into specific complaints of rights violations, and advises the Union and state governments on SC welfare and development.

entities.name: National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
entities.description: Investigates and monitors safeguards for Scheduled Tribes, inquires into specific complaints of rights violations, and advises the Union and state governments on ST welfare and development.

entities.name: National Commission for Backward Classes
entities.description: Examines requests for inclusion/exclusion of communities in the OBC central list and advises the Union government on the welfare and development of socially and educationally backward classes.
entities.legalBasis: Article 338B of the Constitution (constitutional status since the 102nd Amendment, 2018); originally a statutory body under the National Commission for Backward Classes Act, 1993.
entities.notes: Constitutional status granted 2018-08-11 via the 102nd Amendment.

entities.name: Goods and Services Tax Council
entities.description: Joint forum of the Union and state finance ministers that recommends GST rates, exemptions, thresholds and administrative rules; decisions require a weighted majority (Union 1/3, states 2/3 of votes cast).
entities.legalBasis: Article 279A of the Constitution (inserted by the 101st Amendment, 2016)
entities.notes: Chairperson is the Union Finance Minister ex officio (position in-pos-minister-finance, owned by segment council-of-ministers — referenced, not redefined here). Members are the Union Minister of State for Finance and the Finance/other nominated Minister of every state and UT-with-legislature, ex officio; not individually enumerated here (each is the sitting state Finance Minister, owned by the relevant states-* segment).

entities.name: GST Council Secretariat
entities.description: Standing secretariat that services the GST Council, staffed by officers from Union and state governments; headed by a Secretary who is also ex officio the Revenue Secretary.

entities.name: Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities (Commissioner for Linguistic Minorities)
entities.description: A single-officer constitutional post that investigates matters relating to constitutional safeguards for linguistic minorities and reports to the President, who lays the report before Parliament and forwards it to the states concerned.
entities.notes: Office sits administratively under the Ministry of Minority Affairs. Reported to have long periods without a confirmed incumbent; current holder not verified in this pass — see position notes.

entities.name: National Commission for Linguistic Minorities (proposed)
entities.description: A statutory National Commission for Linguistic Minorities (to replace/supplement the single Special Officer above) was recommended by the Sachar Committee (2006) and has been proposed in Parliament at various points; it has not been constituted as an operating body as of the source checked.
entities.legalBasis: Proposed; no dedicated constitutional or statutory instrument currently in force
entities.notes: Included per brief's canonical-ID list; NOT a currently operating body — do not treat as staffed. Flagged for re-verification: confirm whether this remains merely proposed as of 2026.
